title: T13 — Project WBS (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Project WBS — T13 Tool platform

## Work packages

| Node | Work package | Business value | Time criticality | Risk reduction | Job size | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `01a20277-8d10-702f-a975-4dd6469e7b1d` | The tool platform — one governed call path, the call ledger, the schema and effect gates, and tenant-prefixed storage | 8 | 5 | 8 | 5 | accepted |
| `01a20279-82b3-77d7-abf4-19c99e62330b` | The same deliverable, re-planned by the retrospective rework | 8 | 5 | 8 | 5 | open |

The WSJF score is computed from the four integers ((8+5+8)/5 = 4.2); the integers are the row's data
and the score is never stored (§8.2).

## Acceptance

The accepted node is the deliverable the closure rests on: the six §12 clauses, proved by the named
tests in `acceptance/programme/T13.toml`. The second node repeats the same scope; it carries the
same four inputs and is the rework's re-plan of the same deliverable.

## Status

One accepted deliverable (`01a20277…`); one open re-plan node (`01a20279…`). The open node is not
additional scope and is not claimed delivered.
